description:
Get one broadcast in detail: its status, link and settings, the transcriptions it has recorded, and the streams it has used.
Use: before a run to check its settings and link, during one to see listeners and the live transcriptionId, after to find what it recorded. All broadcasts: list_broadcasts. The text: get_transcription with a transcriptionId from here.
Arguments: broadcastId only: the broadcastId field from list_broadcasts or start_broadcast, a 36-character UUID, upper or lower case. A broadcast in the trash is returned too (archived true, restorable with update_broadcast restore true). Not a transcriptionId (not_found), and not the short code at the end of the link listeners open (invalid_options: it must be a UUID). Example: {broadcastId: "0190f0e0-7c1a-7d3e-9b2a-5f4e3d2c1b0a"}.
Behaviour: free and read-only; listenersNow is counted at the moment of the call. Gives rate_limited (with retryAfterS) past 600 calls a minute per API key.
Returns: broadcastId, name, link, access, onAir, listenersNow, lastRecordedAt; while on air transcriptionId, state, onAirSince; transcriptions (up to 20, newest first: transcriptionId, name, recording, lastRecordedAt) and streams (name, url).
Errors: not_found for an unknown broadcastId (or one erased after the restore window); invalid_options for something that is not a UUID.
name: get_broadcast
title: Get a broadcast
